summary: The PHONE is still RINGING in the shop. Trinity tells Neo "You first." Neo answers the PHONE; on a CLICK there is no signal, "Nothing but silence." Trinity asks "What happened?" and Neo replies, "I don't know. It just went dead." Trinity then listens to the dead line and takes out the cellular.

what_changes.before: Waiting for the ringing phone to be answered
what_changes.after: The line has gone dead, cutting off contact
what_changes.evidence: Neo answers the PHONE when there is a CLICK. There is no signal. Nothing but silence.

what_changes.before: Asking what happened to the dead line
what_changes.after: Taking out the cellular to find another way
what_changes.evidence: Trinity listens to the dead line and takes out the cellular.

event_hint.one_line: The escape line goes dead, forcing Trinity to switch to a backup phone.

uncertain: Whether the line going dead was caused by an external threat or a technical failure.
Whether Neo or Trinity will successfully reach their exit before being caught.
